messages:
jake: Heads-up — planning a soft cutover tonight 00:30 UTC for routing-service. Plan: pin current canary, enable new routing flag at 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% over ~45m. Need onwatch and sign-off.

ellie: I'm on. telemetry gating + keep p50/p99 visible. Add EU-West canary cohort.

deploy-bot: Scheduling window: start=2026-03-21T00:30Z; actions=[pin:routing-service@2026-03-21-rc3, ff:set routing_new_path=true cohorts=[0.1%,1%,10%] ramp=[15m,30m], backoff_on_slo=true] 

sre-oncall: Before we flip: run ff-audit for sticky-sessions and kv-cache invalidation. Also run /slo-check --budget 5% and confirm circuit-breaker thresholds.

jake: Pushing the config I'll use below — please eyeball.

```json
{
  "pin": "routing-service@2026-03-21-rc3",
  "feature_flag": "routing_new_path",
  "cohorts": ["0.1%","1%","10%"],
  "ramp_windows": ["15m","30m"],
  "slo_backoff": true,
  "preflight_hooks": ["ff-audit","cache-warm"]
}
```

maria: sign-off if deploy-bot preflight passes (loadgen smoke, deps) and SRE has the SLO gates wired. Also add an emergency soft-disable key: `/ff override routing_new_path=off` in case of p50/P95 blowups.

kate: add a guard: if p50 > 200ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, auto-soft-disable. Put that as a canary holdpoint.

ellie: Recommend warming prefix cache for canary cohorts: `cache-warm --targets=canary-eu,canary-us`. Do it right before cohort bump.

jake: ack. I'll run cache-warm at t+2m before start. Notifying support and product.

deploy-bot: preflight results: ff-audit=OK (no sticky session changes), loadgen smoke=OK, deps=OK. Ready to start. :rocket:

jake: starting in 5. going to kick the deploy. anyone object?

maria: no objections from product. support aware.

sre-oncall: watching. If we hit the holdpoint, prepare manual drain steps. My pager is open.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated. pin applied. routing_new_path set to 0.1% -> verifying telemetry. logs: "deploy: started", "pin: routing-service@2026-03-21-rc3"

ellie: saw initial traffic. metrics: p50=48ms, p99=180ms, error_rate=0.02% (EU-West canary). warming looks good.

deploy-bot: Cohort bump: 0.1% -> 1% initiated. scheduled next bump in 15m.

sre-oncall: monitoring SLOs + tracing for KV cache misses. If noise increases, we'll hit the auto-backoff and drop to 0%.

jake: noting runbook link for postmortem if needed: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-cutover (bookmark).

deploy-bot: Ramp reached 10% at ts=7261234580; no SLO breaches observed. Finalize: leave pin for 2h then evaluate for full rollout.

maria: thanks all. We'll review telemetry in 2h and call for full rollout if stable. :thumbsup:
